label: copy phase, input m/u/o/p/a/w, early or final recalls of long (L=9) sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or the <DEL> step) and only when the fed-back input token has already appeared, so in_first is always 0. It strongly prefers a few input tokens: m, u and o carry about 63% of the mass, then p, a and w; f, r and digits barely fire. Rate depends on absolute step t: it peaks at t=10-12 (recall_idx 1-3, just after <DEL>) and at t=16-17 (the last recalls of L=9 sequences). It is close to silent for L<=6, and L=9 holds about 80% of the mass. Magnitudes are tiny (max 0.008). Restricting to the in_tok set alone gives 0.79 mass recall at only 10% precision, so whether it fires within the preferred token/position cells depends on context that was not identified. The recorded predicate reaches dev F1 about 0.44.
